text_block_list.text:
The day of the Osaka Hai.
The massive crowd's eyes are, of course, fixed on—
(Waaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfeeeee!!
Gentiiiiil~~!!"
Less than half a year after that shocking Japan Cup, the showdown between Orfevre and Gentildonna was realized once more.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I expected as much,
but to think it would be this overwhelming."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I understand the attention on the two of you.
I do, but... it's still frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Of course, I have no intention of leaving things like this.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The heights where those two stand...
The scenery far ahead—the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...And there, I...――

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Good day, Orfevre-san.
Thank you very much for the invitation.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I have granted your wish,
just as you asked.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Deplorable.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Are you perhaps
referring to yourself—?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Listen up first.
(Oooohh...!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Do you know what this is?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It is the lamentation of the common folk,
grieving for my reign.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre...!
This time, bring us absolute victory...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Before the brazen invaders,
the stalwart fortress trembles... and the people are in turmoil.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Utterly pitiful.
And furthermore—disrespectful.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I must make them
fear me once more...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall slay you,
and reign supreme once more.

The pressure Orfevre radiated at that moment...
it had undeniably locked onto Gentildonna.
—It happened before heading out to the paddock. As she went through her usual routine, she suddenly spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Last year, I demonstrated immense power.
That fact will never change.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
However... unless I keep winning,
it will turn into the mere "fluke" everyone expects it to be.

The fact remains that Gentildonna defeated
Orfevre in last year's Japan Cup.
However...
choice_data_list: There was almost no difference in ability.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
That's why we can't let our guard down.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If Orfe-san gives 120%—
if she gets serious, anything can happen."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To guarantee victory,
we need just one more weapon...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Do you happen to have any idea?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You give me answers
from perspectives I could never have on my own.

Both are equally matched, if not more... If so, what remains is mental strength... the sheer obsession with victory—
whichever has that stronger will prevail.

For Gentildonna, who constantly strives to stay at the apex,
it may be hard to truly grasp that perspective, but...
choice_data_list: My determination not to lose to them is stronger than ever.
My determination not to lose to them is stronger than ever.

text_block_list.text:
—Back then, Gentildonna neither
denied nor affirmed it.
And now...
For an instant, Gentildonna turned her gaze somewhere. In the direction she looked—

Verxina casts her eyes downward, looking somewhat insecure.
The feistiness she once showed when confronting her rivals
has completely vanished for now.

However, when I happen to look up
and my eyes meet Gentildonna's—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Orfevre-san. I truly sympathize with the pain in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is entirely my fault for being so soft.
Therefore, today I will be thorough, with utmost sincerity—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I shall crush you utterly.
So thoroughly that no hope for tomorrow remains.
